title: geckolib issue #713: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity.m_142038_()" because "p_91315_" is null

text:
[issue by jediultras]
### **Observed behaviour**

Crash when trying to see any Iron's Spell and Spellbooks enchanted armor. When hovering in inventory (using a mod that renders armor from hovering on it) cause severe lag and when equipped it crashes every player seeing it.

### **Expected behaviour**

Equip and see the armor on.

### **Steps to reproduce**

Take any Iron's Spell and Spellbooks' armor, enchant it, and hover it or equip it, after that, try to look at it with third person, from inventory or from another player perspective -> client who tries this crashes.

### **Server Type**

Third part hosted server (but I guess also singleplayer, not tested though).

### **Crashlog**

https://gist.github.com/jediultras/a92634cef01df287eec2c1f3ac7ee03b

### **Mentioned mods and modloader versions**

forge 47.4.0
geckolib-forge-1.20.1-4.7.1.2
irons_spellbooks-1.20.1-3.4.0.7

### **Other comments**

This is somehow very similar if not identical to #616, https://github.com/iron431/irons-spells-n-spellbooks/issues/653 and https://github.com/iron431/irons-spells-n-spellbooks/issues/524, so, obviously I tried to update all listed mods but it did not fix it. I am on minecraft 1.20.1, I looked at those older issues but they are almost all referred to minecraft 1.21.1. I posted this here, because the crash log says this is the suspected mod, but if you tell me that is an Iron's Spell and Spellbooks problem I'll post it there asap!

[comment by Tslat (collaborator)]
I can't see any way this would happen other than not calling prepForRender prior to passing the GeoArmorRenderer as required, or by passing a null entity.

Neither of those are on GeckoLib's side.

If we want to take this further I'm going to need to do it in Discord where we can discuss the code used and such, but given that it seems to be almost exclusively irons-spells that has the issue as well, I'm pretty inclined to say it's not on GeckoLib's side
